##### Project general facts

Future Residence by True Future Real Estate Development is an exceptional residential project poised to redefine luxury living. This modern landmark features sleek lines and warm lighting, blending contemporary design with natural surroundings. Offering a refined selection of one-bedroom apartments, units with private pools, and spacious two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, each home is thoughtfully planned with high-quality finishes and integrated smart home systems, providing sweeping views of Dubai’s iconic skyline and surrounding greenery.

Residents of Future Residence are welcomed into a world of outstanding amenities that enrich everyday life with comfort and leisure. The development includes nine swimming pools, two state-of-the-art gyms, a yoga retreat, a golf course, beautifully landscaped gardens, dedicated kids' play areas, BBQ zones, jogging paths, and spaces designed for social gatherings. Every element is crafted to offer wellness, recreation, and community connection at every corner.

Every residence at Future Residence is fully furnished and decorated, featuring modern finishing with high-quality materials and smart home systems. The meticulously crafted interiors are enhanced by breathtaking views of Dubai's evolving skyline, lush landscaped spaces, and the vibrant pulse of futuristic developments. Kitchens are fully equipped, and each home is designed to be a symbol of modern luxury, innovation, and refined urban living.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Meydan City, this extraordinary community is known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning a vast area, Meydan offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment. The iconic Meydan Racecourse, host of the prestigious Dubai World Cup, creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and lush green spaces. Expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorn the community, offering leisurely walks, bike rides, and picnics in serene surroundings. Dubai International Airport, the Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Meydan Racecourse, Burj Al Arab, and Jumeirah Beach are all within easy reach, ensuring unmatched connectivity while maintaining the exclusivity of a private sanctuary.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern luxury, serene living, and a prime Meydan address, Future Residence delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, natural beauty, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — sophisticated, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
